description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for the Next.js template initialization and project setup in a software project. It includes fixtures for creating temporary directories and mock template structures, as well as tests for verifying template info retrieval, project initialization, parameter application, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and template variable replacements.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for testing.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that sets up a mock template directory with configuration and files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a sample ProjectConfig object with basic project metadata.

methods.name: test_nextjs_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests that the template provides correct initialization info, specifically checking the 'configure_environment' command.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that a project can be successfully initialized and that files are correctly created with placeholders replaced.

methods.name: test_parameter_defaults(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures default parameters are applied when none are provided explicitly.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that post-processing scripts are executed correctly after project setup.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading of project configuration from a JSON file into the ProjectConfig dataclass.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template variables within files are properly replaced with project parameters.
